Eligibility Criteria
The following four groups were eligible for the Collab.Land airdrop:
Verified Community Members
in Discord or Telegram (Snapshot taken on 02/14/23).
Collab.Land’s Top 100 Discord communities
(based on membership, longevity, and activity).
Collab.Land Patron NFT holders
(Token numbers 0-141) – Each NFT could claim tokens once.
Collab.Land Membership NFT holders
– Each NFT could claim tokens once.
Eligible users did
not
need to pay gas fees or connect their wallet to claim.
Tokens were distributed via the
wagmi.collab.land
website.
The
Top 100 Discord Communities
determined how they would use or distribute
15% of the total COLLAB supply
through the Community Claim Process.

DAO Governance:
